policy: The v1.6.0 contract is frozen: each active source's URL building, list parsing and JD fetch live in jobs_scraper/sources/<source>.py, and sg_product_jobs.py keeps only thin wrappers over them — one implementation per behaviour, verified by AST. The active CLI sources are linkedin, jobstreet, cake and 104/onezerofour; jora stays retired from active crawling and is kept only for back-compat dedup of historical rows. Every source adapter's list fetch retries a transient 429/5xx/connection/JSON failure with a 30/60/90s ladder (four attempts), raises any other 4xx without retrying, and never retries a legitimately empty page; a run counts as successful only when the list crawl actually produced pages, because an empty crawl exits 0 by design. The engine's title filter, Sheet write order, cross-source identity, work-mode values and single-source-of-truth crawl state are unchanged by this release; future source expansion or retirement requires an explicit authorized contract change.
